Backup: ten host POBIERA migawki ze źród:
Backup: this host PULLS snapshots from the source and keeps them.
Mirror: the same datasets under the same path and the same snapshots:
what disappears at the source disappears here too (no retention of its own).
Local copy: a copy on the same host, e.g. rpool/data -> hdd/backup.
Local snapshots: snapshots and their prune in this host's datasets, no copies.
Remote snapshots: this host makes and prunes snapshots ON another host, no copies.
